title: FemTheme Solo #009 · 여 아마조네스·GermanGlam·서퍼 테마

Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult German woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair cool-toned skin, soft taupe eyeshadow, a glossy nude-pink lip, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in an intricate fishtail braid, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a gold cube-shaped block, an iron chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, an iron small flared temple bell, a lead square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted emerald drop with a heavy rough copper a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre hanging at its end, and a single silver bracelet. Extremely long round nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.

SUBJECT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a shark-tooth necklace, a tiny neon-orange micro-bikini top of two small opaque triangle cups on thin strings tied at the neck and back, fully covering her bust, and a minimal neon-orange micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, soaked and clinging, water streaming down her whole body in glistening rivulets with countless droplets clinging to her skin, her hair soaking wet and slicked.
SUBJECT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme hot-pink platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material glowing softly under the diffused light, the gentle light modelling every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
